# Trending Niches

> Clear, sourced guides to the topics people are just starting to search for.

- [Becoming Chinese trend: what it is and how to try it](https://upgrades.xkey.co.uk/becoming-chinese/): The 2026 TikTok trend of adopting everyday Chinese habits: where it started, the main habits, what it costs to try and the criticism.
- [Jirai-kei and ryōsan-gata fashion: a plain guide](https://upgrades.xkey.co.uk/jirai-kei-and-ry-san-gata-fashion/): What Japan's "landmine" and "mass-produced" styles are, how they differ, what they cost, the darker associations, and how to start.
- [Nihilist penguin meme: what it is and where it came from](https://upgrades.xkey.co.uk/nihilistic-penguin/): The lone penguin walking to the mountains: the Herzog clip behind it, how it went viral in January 2026, what it means and the political row.
